children.help: Mute button. Silence a track's signal, audibly removing it from the overall project.
Solo button. Isolate a track's signal from the overall composition so it can be heard alone.
Monitoring button. Hear incoming signals on audio tracks that are not record-enabled. This is useful when setting levels or practising parts before recording.
Pan/Balance knob. Drag vertically to position the track signal in the stereo field.
Volume slider. Set a track's playback volume. Use on the master track to set the overall project volume.
Name field. Double-click to rename the track.
Track header. Use to mute or solo the track’s signal, arm the track for recording, and adjust volume or pan. You can also set a groove track to which other tracks match their timing.
